style_lock: Commercial product photography. Soft key light from upper left, 5000K daylight, subtle cool rim light from behind. 85mm lens, f/5.6. Neutral color grade with {{palette}} accents, deep but not crushed shadows, true-to-life material textures. Consistent look across the whole series, as if shot in one studio session.
constraints: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no UI elements, no people unless stated. Do not invent product features that are not described.

shots.prompt: Website hero image for a product landing page. Subject: {{product}}, made of {{materials}}, with {{details}} clearly visible. Scene: placed on a dark matte surface in a minimal studio, background a smooth gradient in {{palette}}. Composition: product in the right third at three-quarter angle, slightly below eye level, large clean negative space on the left for a headline.

Vertical website hero image for mobile. Subject: {{product}}, made of {{materials}}, with {{details}} clearly visible. Scene: same studio and surface as the desktop hero, background a smooth gradient in {{palette}}. Composition: product in the lower half, centered, three-quarter angle, clean empty space in the upper third for a headline.

Product packshot for a website catalog block. Subject: {{product}}, made of {{materials}}. Scene: seamless light-grey background, soft contact shadow under the product. Composition: product centered, three-quarter front view, fills about 60 percent of the frame, entire product in sharp focus.

Macro detail shot for a website section about materials. Subject: close-up of {{details}} on {{product}}, showing the surface texture of {{materials}}. Composition: tight crop, diagonal edge leading through the frame, focus on the texture, background falls off into soft blur. Raking side light that reveals the surface relief.

Website image showing the product in its real working environment. Subject: {{product}} in use in {{environment}}. Scene: realistic, tidy, believable location with natural wear, no staged clutter. Composition: product is the clear focal point in the left two thirds, environment readable but secondary, eye-level documentary angle.

Website image for a section about how the product is made or installed. Subject: {{product}} during assembly or installation, only hands in work gloves visible, no faces. Scene: clean workshop bench, tools neatly placed. Composition: top-down three-quarter view, product in the center, hands entering from the lower edge.

Abstract background texture for a website section behind text. Subject: soft-focus close-up of {{materials}} surface. Composition: even, low-contrast, no focal point, no hard edges, darker toward the edges so white text stays readable. Colors limited to {{palette}}.
